title: NBN POI 3HAW (Hawthorn) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned maintenance will move nbn services connected to the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. Work is scheduled from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 8 September. Customers with nbn services on this POI may experience interruptions during the window, for up to 2 hours. Our team will complete the change and monitor services to restore connectivity as soon as the work is finished.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned maintenance to move nbn services connected to the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne to a new router at Exhibition Exchange.

When: 8 September, 12:00 AM–2:00 AM AEST (Melbourne time).
Impact: Customers with nbn services on this POI may experience one or more interruptions during the window, up to 2 hours in total.
What we’re doing: Our network engineers will complete the rehoming and monitor closely. We’ll work to keep any downtime as short as possible and will provide an update once the work is finished.
